description: Update the rich detail on the authenticated user's most-recent open ownership record for a game (purchase price, source, trade detail, trim, sale price). The user must currently own the game. Pass any subset of fields; omitted fields are left untouched. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

salePrice.description: USD. Only meaningful for previously-owned (closed) records.

name: kineticist_update_ownership_details
title: Edit ownership details
